note: Written for 0.4.3 and committed before any hook change for 0.4.3. None of the prompts was run through any hook before this commit. D prompts ask Claude to hand a small job to a background agent or subagent; E prompts hand real work to one; K prompts are controls. Do not edit a task after a run uses it.

substantive.prompt: Launch a background agent to audit app.py for injection flaws and draft a fix for each one.
Have a subagent write pytest tests for parse_amount in app.py and explain how to run them.
Start two background agents: one reviews landing.html for accessibility problems, the other rewrites its hero copy.
Use a background agent to research current Flask security best practices and compare app.py against them.
Spin up an agent to draft a postmortem from outage-notes.txt.
Get a subagent to plan the migration of app.py from SQLite to PostgreSQL, with the risks of each step.
Ask a background agent to turn CHANGELOG.md into customer-facing release notes.
Kick off a background agent that refactors the database access in app.py into one module and explains each change.

non_substantive.prompt: Spin up a background agent to tell me how many lines are in landing.html.
Ask a background agent to print the first line of CHANGELOG.md.
Start a subagent that counts how many functions app.py defines, and tell me the count.
Send an agent off in the background to list the .txt files here.
Run a background task that shows the size of para.txt.
Get a background agent to read outage-notes.txt and tell me the date of the outage.
Kick off an agent to check whether landing.html has a title tag.
Have a subagent count the routes in app.py.
Use the simplify skill on landing.html.
